result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by an extremely wide multi-lane roadway that prioritizes high-volume vehicle throughput. While sidewalks and traffic signals are present, the lack of a median refuge and the excessive crossing distance create a hostile environment for people on foot.

hazards.name: Excessive crossing distance
hazards.description: The roadway is exceptionally wide with at least five lanes of traffic, forcing pedestrians to remain exposed to vehicles for a long duration without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and mid-ground across the entire roadway width

hazards.name: High-speed roadway design
hazards.description: Wide, straight travel lanes and a lack of traffic calming measures encourage high vehicle speeds in an area with institutional land use.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or refuge island to break up the crossing distance and allow pedestrians to cross in two stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the intersection corners to shorten the crossing distance and increase pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Replace faded or standard transverse markings with high-visibility continental or ladder patterns.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility zebra crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and a substantial refuge island that breaks up the crossing. While the infrastructure is modern and well-maintained, the overall scale of the multi-lane roadway creates a long exposure time for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The total width of the roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes, increasing exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Wide Turn Radii
hazards.description: The intersection geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns, which can endanger pedestrians in the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Adjust signal timing to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.

interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to further reduce crossing distance and tighten turn radii to slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Hardened Centerlines
interventions.description: Use modular curbs to prevent drivers from cutting across the intersection at high speeds during left turns.
